AutoSpace 0.5.0-beta.7 is the seventh public beta — a prerelease, on the beta line.

## New features
- No new features in this release.

## Improvements
- The app now calls itself Beta everywhere it used to say alpha: the welcome line on first setup said "alpha" even though the version has been a beta since 0.5.0-beta.1, and the same for the version note in the app's description. Beta builds already defaulted to the Beta update channel; the words now match.

## Bug fixes
- No bug fixes in this release.

## Maintenance
- No maintenance changes in this release.
